title: Planet Tweaks V2.9.8 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Whole-App 2-Column Remodel, Snap Tap, Media Remaps & PC-Breaker Guard
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V2.9.8 NOVA TITAN: (1) Whole-App Compact 2-Column Hardware-Utility UI Remodel across every tweak tab, Input & Crosshair, and Windows Tools with all duplicate buttons purged. (2) Full PC-Breaker & Input-Lockout Protection: fixed stuck Alt/Ctrl/Shift modifiers in low-level keyboard hooks, shipped 1-click Unstick Keys & Emergency Panic Killswitch recovery, blocked NVMe/AHCI storage MSI boot-loops, added 15-second auto-revert black-screen protection to Stretched Resolution switcher, and fixed Reduce Input Lag. (3) PowerToys-Style Media Key Remaps (Play/Pause, Next, Previous, Volume Mute/Up/Down) + 1,000MB Chrome Background RAM Killer. (4) New 🎲 Random Hub with 5 Square Sub-Tabs: ⚡ Snap Tap / SOCD, 🚀 Custom Pre-Launch Routine Builder, ⌨️ Live Anti-Ghosting NKRO Matrix & Reversible Fixer, 📐 Sensitivity & eDPI Converter, and 📦 Shareable Setup Codes. (5) Permanent Sidebar & Tab Layout Persistence across updates.
